title: Three-phase switch-level short-window comparison
scope: behavioral switch-level screening only; no manufacturer MOS macro, no closed-loop FOC, no 1s motor-power proof

interpretation.pac: measured three-phase motor-terminal power; requested setpoint is not substituted for measured power
interpretation.pbus: measured inverter DC-port power, separate from battery/source current
interpretation.isource: measured through the Thevenin battery source; local DC-link capacitors carry switching ripple
interpretation.ibus: instantaneous inverter DC-port current, including local capacitor pulse current; not an external-source current limit measurement
interpretation.regen: fixed-speed back-EMF source represents a mechanical energy reservoir; reverse battery acceptance is blocked in these switch cases
interpretation.comparison: legacy and filtered runs have different durations and are not an apples-to-apples motor qualification

cases.label: legacy_direct_bus_feedback
cases.result_file: 归档/历史与调试.zip::FOC驱动模块/仿真/runs/switch_profile_results.json
cases.netlist_file: 归档/历史与调试.zip::FOC驱动模块/仿真/runs/switch32p4_regen1800W_5ms_max20ns/model.cir
cases.status: INVALID_AS_HARDWARE_PREDICTION: instantaneous PWM duty division by switching bus voltage; retained only as pre-fix comparison

parameters.name: switch32p4_regen1800W_5ms_max20ns
parameters.ke_conversion: E_phase_peak = ke_scale * rpm/(sqrt(3)*KV); convention uncertainty is a sweep input
parameters.source_reverse_acceptance: blocked by Dsrc in this initial no-absorption baseline
parameters.arming: global gate-command ramp to requested PWM pattern over 2e-06 s; transient is reported separately from post-arm PWM interval
parameters.mosfet_behavior_model: passive behavioral B-channel conductance capped to 0..10V normalized command, Ron=0.005 ohm selected hot screen; no vendor macro model; fixed Coss=2.3e-09 F/device; behavioral body diode; gate transition timing from smoothed PWM comparator
parameters.bridge_bypass_model: 3 phase-leg branches, each one 4.7uF ceramic assumed 2.35uF at bias plus 0.1uF, Ceff=2.45e-06 F/leg; ESR=0.005 ohm, ESL=1e-09 H; bulk bank is separate
parameters.ov_comparator_timing: behavior-level threshold only; no official TLV1704 macro or worst-case propagation delay; independent BJT/OVP network checked separately
parameters.data_scope: meas summary plus ngspice binary raw file; actual results not closed-loop FOC qualification
